note: Analysis and condition specification extracted from the pre-acquisition plan; acquisition controls are omitted.

TILT_XP.instruction: Keep contact at C and deliberately apply a small +X-directed downward oblique push; do not tilt the entire apparatus or slide to X+

OFFSET_XP15.instruction: Press vertically at the X+ mark, 15 mm from C, not at the tray rim

analysis.unit: One press, not individual ADC samples; five planned presses per condition in five interleaved blocks
analysis.baseline: Final 5 s before actual PRESS_GO cue of each press, while hand is removed; report its drift and return separately
analysis.primary_window: Last 100 consecutive raw samples with host_utc_ns strictly before actual READ_CUE; require window inside HOLD_START..READ_CUE; no selection by error or contrast
analysis.channel_response: r_i = preceding unloaded channel mean - loaded channel mean; q = mean(r_i)
analysis.contrasts: c24 = r2-r4, c31 = r3-r1, Q = sqrt(c24^2+c31^2); no automatic interpretation as force direction or angle
analysis.primary_question: How do the two signed channel contrasts and their magnitude differ under the three prescribed loading instructions at a common approximate vertical scale indication?
analysis.primary_summary: Show every press and condition median/range for c24, c31, Q and q; paired TILT-CENTER and OFFSET-CENTER vectors within each block; report individual block consistency and magnitude differences, including negative or mixed changes
analysis.direction_check: Descriptive agreement of the TILT-CENTER vector with the OFFSET-CENTER vector in each block via dot product; both cues use marked +X. This tests response-pattern consistency, not calibrated angle or independent directional accuracy.
analysis.load_sensitivity: Also report u=(c24/q,c31/q) and matched-block changes only for q>0 and an in-range primary force response; do not select whichever representation separates best. Show actual scale indications alongside contrasts.
analysis.secondary_error: Frozen piecewise-linear force estimate using the same preceding zero minus manual CRW-7024 reading at READ_CUE, g and N. For observed ranges retain endpoints; no midpoint, MAE or RMSE from range/missing entries.
analysis.error_association: Descriptive Spearman association of Q and normalized magnitude with absolute difference for single-number scale readings; pooled and within-condition centered views, with n shown. No fitted error-correction or classifier.
analysis.sensitivity_window: All samples in final 3 s before READ_CUE, constrained to HOLD_START..READ_CUE; report separately without replacing primary window
analysis.eligibility: Preserve all planned attempts and explicit repeats. Flag interrupted cues, sample gaps, missed reading, contact sliding, support contact, saturation, unstable hold, pre-zero instability or reset. Missing scale reading removes only secondary error pairing. No force-error- or contrast-based exclusion; do not silently replace flagged attempts.
analysis.unstable_hold: Report each channel SD and drift over the 5 s hold; SD>15 ADC is a flag, not automatic deletion because intended loading can vary
no_claims: independent validation of the frozen force model
